nodes.description: Address payable storing the protocol fee wallet in AugustusStorage; updated by setFeeWallet and set in the constructor.
ITokenTransferProxy instance created in the AugustusSwapper constructor and used to pull user tokens.
Mapping from function selector to router implementation address; written by setImplementation and read by getImplementation.
Mapping of partner address to FeeStructure holding partner share, fee percent and metadata.
Mapping tracking which adapters have been initialized via initializeAdapter.
Mapping storing initialization payloads for routers.
Private owner address in Ownable, controls onlyOwner guarded functions such as TokenTransferProxy.transferFrom.
Role identifier required for an adapter to be initialized by initializeAdapter.
Constructor of AugustusSwapper: deploys TokenTransferProxy, sets feeWallet and grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to the deployer.
Payable fallback that resolves the router implementation from msg.sig and delegatecalls into it with the raw calldata.
Admin-only function that delegatecalls IAdapter.initialize on a whitelisted adapter.
Admin-only function that delegatecalls IRouter.initialize on a whitelisted router.
Admin-only setter for the feeWallet state variable.
Admin-only function registering a partner FeeStructure in registeredPartners with validation of shares and fee percent.
Admin-only function binding a function selector to a whitelisted router implementation in selectorVsRouter.
Admin-only rescue function sending ETH via a low-level call with 10000 gas or tokens via safeTransfer.
Public view returning the router implementation address stored for a given selector.
TokenTransferProxy external onlyOwner function pulling tokens from 'from' to 'to', requiring tx.origin or contract checks.
AccessControl function granting a role after checking the caller holds the role admin; calls _grantRole.
Internal AccessControl helper granting a role without caller checks, used only during construction/setup.
Private AccessControl helper that adds the account to the role member set and emits RoleGranted.
Modifier requiring the caller to hold DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE; guards all AugustusSwapper admin functions.
Ownable modifier requiring _owner == _msgSender(); guards TokenTransferProxy.transferFrom.
External caller address (msg.sender) used in access checks, role checks and owner checks.
Transaction origin (tx.origin) used as the 'from' address validity condition in TokenTransferProxy.transferFrom.
Low-level delegatecall in the payable fallback that executes arbitrary router bytecode in the swapper's storage context.
Delegatecall in initializeAdapter executing attacker-influenced data against a whitelisted adapter address.
Delegatecall in initializeRouter executing attacker-influenced data against a whitelisted router address.
Low-level call{value: amount, gas: 10000} transferring ETH to an arbitrary destination in transferTokens.
External token transferFrom call performed through SafeERC20 in TokenTransferProxy.transferFrom.
Parameter 'adapter' (address) of initializeAdapter, the delegatecall target.
Parameter 'router' (address) of initializeRouter, the delegatecall target.
Constructor parameter '_feeWallet' assigned to the feeWallet state variable.
Parameter 'implementation' of setImplementation written into selectorVsRouter.
Parameter 'selector' (bytes4) used as key into selectorVsRouter in getImplementation/setImplementation.
Parameter 'token' (address) of transferFrom, the ERC20 token being moved.
Parameter 'from' (address) of transferFrom, the account tokens are pulled from.
Parameter 'to' (address) of transferFrom, the recipient of the tokens.
Parameter 'amount' (uint256) of transferFrom and transferTokens.
Parameter 'partner' (address) used as key into registeredPartners in registerPartner.
Parameter 'role' (bytes32) of grantRole, the role being granted.
Parameter 'account' (address) of grantRole, the account receiving the role.
Parameter 'destination' (address payable) receiving ETH or tokens in transferTokens.
Calldata 'data' bytes forwarded to adapters/routers inside initializeAdapter and initializeRouter delegatecalls.
Local variable 'implementation' in fallback holding the router address resolved from msg.sig.
Local bool 'success' returned by the delegatecall in fallback.
Local bytes 'resultData' returned by the delegatecall in fallback and bubbled up via _returnWithData.
Local bytes4 'selector' assigned from msg.sig in the fallback for implementation lookup.

edges.reason: Any external account can reach the payable fallback through msg.sender, which then dispatches to a router implementation.
onlyAdmin restricts initializeAdapter to holders of DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
onlyAdmin restricts initializeRouter to holders of DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
onlyAdmin restricts setFeeWallet to holders of DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
onlyAdmin restricts registerPartner to holders of DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
onlyAdmin restricts setImplementation to holders of DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
onlyAdmin restricts the transferTokens rescue function to holders of DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
onlyOwner restricts TokenTransferProxy.transferFrom so only the swapper contract (owner) can pull user tokens.
grantRole enforces admin-role checks before delegating the actual grant to _grantRole.
The fallback performs a delegatecall with raw msg.data to the resolved implementation contract.
initializeAdapter executes a delegatecall into the adapter after whitelist verification.
initializeRouter executes a delegatecall into the router after whitelist verification.
transferTokens performs a low-level call with value to an arbitrary destination.
transferFrom performs an external ERC20 transferFrom through SafeERC20.
Constructor parameter _feeWallet is written into the feeWallet state variable.
Constructor creates a new TokenTransferProxy and stores it in tokenTransferProxy.
setFeeWallet writes the supplied address into the feeWallet state variable.
registerPartner writes partner share, fee percent and metadata into registeredPartners.
setImplementation writes the router address into selectorVsRouter keyed by selector.
getImplementation reads the router address from the selectorVsRouter mapping.
The selector parameter is used as the lookup key in getImplementation.
The implementation address returned by getImplementation is used by the fallback for its delegatecall.
Local variable selector (msg.sig) is passed to getImplementation to resolve the router.
Attacker-supplied calldata is ABI-encoded and forwarded into the adapter delegatecall.
Attacker-supplied calldata is ABI-encoded and forwarded into the router delegatecall.
The adapter parameter is the target address of the delegatecall in initializeAdapter.
The router parameter is the target address of the delegatecall in initializeRouter.
The destination parameter is the recipient of the low-level value transfer in transferTokens.
Constructor parameter _feeWallet flows into the deployment-time fee wallet assignment.
The from parameter is passed as the source account to the token transferFrom call.
The to parameter is passed as the recipient to the token transferFrom call.
The amount parameter is passed as the value to the token transferFrom call.
The token parameter determines the ERC20 contract on which safeTransferFrom is invoked.
tx.origin is used in the 'from == tx.origin || from.isContract()' condition, making the check dependent on the transaction origin.
onlyAdmin evaluates hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender) to authorise callers.
onlyOwner compares _owner against _msgSender() derived from msg.sender.
grantRole checks that msg.sender holds the admin role of the granted role.
The role parameter selects which role is granted and whose adminRole is checked.
The account parameter is the address that receives the granted role.
The partner parameter is used as the mapping key for the FeeStructure stored in registeredPartners.
The implementation parameter is stored as the router for the given selector.
The external token transferFrom call hands control to arbitrary token code that can re-enter the proxy or swapper before state is finalised.
The low-level value transfer forwards control (with 10000 gas) to an arbitrary destination that may re-enter transferTokens.
The delegatecall transfers execution to an untrusted router implementation which can re-enter the fallback or other swapper entry points.

normalization_plan.reason: The adapter parameter only exists to supply the delegatecall target inside initializeAdapter.
The router parameter only exists to supply the delegatecall target inside initializeRouter.
The _feeWallet constructor parameter is immediately consumed by the constructor when setting feeWallet.
The implementation parameter is directly written into selectorVsRouter by setImplementation.
The selector parameter is only used as the mapping key when reading selectorVsRouter in getImplementation.
The token parameter only identifies the ERC20 contract for the safeTransferFrom invocation.
The from parameter is only an argument to the external transferFrom call.
The to parameter is only an argument to the external transferFrom call.
The amount parameter is only an argument to the external transferFrom call.
The partner parameter only acts as the mapping key inside registerPartner.
The role parameter only feeds the role-admin lookup in grantRole.
The account parameter only feeds the member addition performed via grantRole.
The destination parameter is only the recipient of the low-level value transfer in transferTokens.
The data calldata is only encoded and forwarded into the adapter delegatecall in initializeAdapter.
The local implementation variable only holds the target of the fallback delegatecall.
The local success flag only records the delegatecall outcome in the fallback.
The local resultData buffer only carries the delegatecall return data out of the fallback.
The local selector from msg.sig only feeds the implementation lookup.
